mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.success) AS successCount, COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.success) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS successRate, COALESCE(SUM(e.prompt_tokens), 0) AS totalPromptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(e.completion_tokens), 0) AS totalCompletionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(e.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(AVG(e.duration_ms), 0) AS avgDurationMs, COALESCE(MAX(e.duration_ms), 0) AS maxDurationMs FROM usage_event e

SELECT
e.model_id e.scene CAST(e.user_id AS VARCHAR)
AS groupKey, COUNT(*) AS requestCount, COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.success) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS successRate, COALESCE(SUM(e.prompt_tokens), 0) AS totalPromptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(e.completion_tokens), 0) AS totalCompletionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(e.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(AVG(e.duration_ms), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM usage_event e
GROUP BY
e.model_id e.scene e.user_id
ORDER BY
requestCount avgDurationMs totalTokens
ASC DESC

WITH buckets AS ( SELECT generate_series( date_trunc(#{unit}, #{filter.start}::timestamptz), date_trunc(#{unit}, #{filter.end}::timestamptz), #{step}::interval ) AS bucket ) SELECT b.bucket AS bucket, COUNT(e.id) AS requestCount, COALESCE(SUM(e.prompt_tokens), 0) AS totalPromptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(e.completion_tokens), 0) AS totalCompletionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(e.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN usage_event e ON date_trunc(#{unit}, e.created_at) = b.bucket
GROUP BY b.bucket ORDER BY b.bucket
